answer: A workable design: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The kernel of work and the summit of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ledge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
